name: Strana Bezumija
source:
A single slip sent Arseniy into another world, where desserts talk, aristocrats speak backwards, and girls drift like illusions. Fate offers threads – some bright, some dark. Which will he pick?

[From [url=https://goydastudios.itch.io/the-land-of-madness]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一次失误，让阿尔谢尼进入了另一个世界，在那里，甜点说话，贵族说话倒着说，女孩子如幻境般漂流。命运提供了线索——有些明亮，有些黑暗。他会选择哪个？

[来自[url=https://goydastudios.itch.io/the-land-of-madness]Itch.io[/url]]
